scope: 57 non-시각 표본 일치 cases in existing 119-photo results; frozen sparse references and actual service response; no new inference. Recommendations are not approved product policy. Correction time/clicks unmeasured.

definitions.correctionBurden: none means no user correction inferred from reference-error judgment, targeted means one or few sampled items/fields to review, substantial means sampled scope needs broad manual reconstruction, unmeasured means evidence does not bound actual UI work. No time/click claim.
definitions.acceptability: acceptable-with-confirmation still needs explicit user confirmation/input; needs-targeted-correction cannot auto-confirm; not-acceptable-for-auto-restore lacks adequate per-object state or product save; cannot-judge is held from model-quality claims.
